register(command: CapabilityCommand): void - register command ke in-memory store

programmatic_gates.description: CLI tool untuk verifikasi gate execution (GATE-C command) - verifikasi replayability dan evidence canonicality

specialized_routes_verified: external-webhooks/[provider]/[endpoint] (commsme, email, forms, ilc, midtrans, whatsapp)

trace_verification.full_flow_path: Route/Entry → Capability/Command → Actor/Auth → Execution → Mutation → Persistence → Evidence → Consumer/Compatibility

trace_segments.details: Universal HTTP gateway menerima request, resolve alias capability prefix (auth→identity.), panggil capabilityRegistry.invoke()
Session validation (cookie+body), role-based authorization check via WorkflowDefinition.requiredRoles, anonymous session isolation
ExecutionContext via AsyncLocalStorage propagasi actor_id, tenant_id, workflow_id; idempotency key generated; command.execute() dipanggil dengan context tracking
State mutation via repository pattern; semua perubahan state tercatat dengan context trace_id; cross-tenant mutation dicek
Artifacts disimpan ke filesystem/db dengan SHA-256 contentHash; execution artifacts ter-link ke requirement ID
recordEvidence command dipanggil; EvidenceSchema validasi; evidence disimpan dengan session/tenant/workspace isolation; tidak bisa diubah setelah disimpan (read-only repository)

Evidence dibaca oleh semua consumer: requirements-traceability-matrix (RTM), observability (metrics/logs), api-platform (delivery gateway), knowledge-graph, workflow-engine; compatibility terjaga via EvidenceSchema yang konsisten

session_validation.description: WORKSPACE_SESSION_COOKIE decode and authentication before any command execution

workflow_enforcement.description: Enforces WorkflowDefinition steps, required roles, idempotency states (PREPARED/DISPATCHED/ACKNOWLEDGED/COMPLETED)

FACTS: EOS memiliki 3 jenis programmatic gate utama: Universal HTTP Gateway, Core Capability Registry, CLI Verification Gate
Core capabilityRegistry sekarang mengimplementasikan 4 method: invoke(), register(), listCommandKeys(), resolveByParts()
Universal HTTP gateway di /api/capabilities/[cap]/[commandName] menangani SEMUA capability command execution via POST DAN GET (introspeksi)
Semua dynamic import di core registry dinonaktifkan (REALITY PATH compliant)
Workflow transition enforcement terimplementasi dengan role-based access dan idempotency guard
Session validation terimplementasi di semua server-side API routes yang mengakses capabilityRegistry
Prefix alias resolution terimplementasi: auth→identity., tenant→identity., ws→identity., session→identity. (sesuai test expectations)
GAP-CORE-001 dan GAP-CORE-002 RESOLVED: listCommandKeys() dan resolveByParts() fully implemented dengan MINIMAL FIX
Actor identity system support MULTIPLE actor types: human (user-), AI (ai-), IoT (iot-), machine (machine-), eos-system (eos-) sesuai MA-09 compliance
Role-based authorization di executeWorkflowTransition() memvalidasi requiredRoles sebelum mengizinkan mutasi state
Idempotency state enforcement: PREPARED/DISPATCHED/ACKNOWLEDGED/COMPLETED mencegah re-execution langkah workflow yang sudah selesai
Session propagation: workspace-session dikirim sebagai header x-eos-* ke semua downstream services
SELURUH TRACE SELESAI: Route/Entry→Capability/Command→Actor/Auth→Execution→Mutation→Persistence→Evidence→Consumer/Compatibility SEMUA terverifikasi
Evidence registry memiliki 6 consumer terverifikasi: RTM, observability, api-platform, knowledge-graph, workflow-engine, requirement-management
Evidence disimpan sebagai read-only: tidak bisa diubah setelah dicatat (EvidenceRegistryRepositoryFileSystem.save() throws error)
ExecutionContext via AsyncLocalStorage propagasi semua context (actor, tenant, workflow) ke seluruh stack
workspace.manifest.ts mendaftarkan 8 capability aktif: identity, consultation, legal-case, communication, work-core, requirement-management (disabled), evidence-registry (disabled)
Command registration manual: semua command harus di-register secara eksplisit via capabilityRegistry.registerCommand() atau capabilityRegistry.register(), tidak ada auto-registration
Total capabilities dengan persistence layer: 20+ yang terdeteksi dengan repository pola yang konsisten
Semua persistence layer mengimplementasikan base.repository.ts abstract class (toRecord()/toAggregate())
Pemisahan read/write database di implementasi Postgres (case-postgres.repository.ts, communication.postgres.repository.ts)
Semua evidence repository adalah read-only: tidak ada method save() yang bisa mengubah data setelah dicatat
UNKNOWNS: Apakah ada gate lain (gRPC, message queue) selain HTTP dan CLI yang terimplementasi
Verifikasi semua Postgres repository mengimplementasikan connection pooling yang sama
Total command yang aktif dieksekusi di production (tidak hanya terdaftar)

GAPS.description: loadCapabilityCommands() returns empty object - tidak ada command yang terload secara otomatis; semua command harus diimport langsung di route.ts
GAPS.impact: Hanya command yang diimport di specific route yang dapat dieksekusi; tidak ada auto-discovery

VERDICTS.reuse_potential: 95% - core infrastructure sudah complete, tinggal gap runtime loadCapabilityCommands() yang sudah sesuai policy
VERDICTS.overall_assessment: EOS sudah memiliki fundamental programmatic surface yang solid dan fully operational untuk semua capability command execution
